parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Express general point of a line in component form, e.g. $(1+2s,3-s,2+3s)$ or $(2+t,1-t,4+4t)$ - B1. Equate at least two pairs of components and solve for $s$ or $t$ - M1. Obtain a correct answer for $s$ or $t$; possible answers are $-1,6,2/5$ for $s$ and $-3,4,-1/5$ for $t$ - A1. Verify that all three component equations are not satisfied - A1. Show that the lines are not parallel and are thus skew - A1. Total: 5.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Carry out correct process for evaluating the scalar product of the direction vectors - M1. Using the correct process for the moduli, divide the scalar product by the product of the moduli and evaluate the inverse cosine of the result - M1. Obtain $19.1^\circ$ or $0.333$ radians - A1. Total: 3.
